# Scenario: relative bind with path traversal (../) is rejected with
# security_violation / disallowed_bind_mount; prior container stays running.

cd git-repo
exec git init -b main
exec git config user.email 'test@apinfra.local'
exec git config user.name 'Test Agent'
exec git add .
exec git commit -m 'feat: baseline without traversal bind'
cd ..

cp .apinfra.template .apinfra
exec sh -c 'echo "repo=file://'$WORK'/git-repo" >> .apinfra'

exec apinfra
stderr 'done duration='
docker-assert-running apinfra_e2e-pltrav-web

cd git-repo
cp ../compose.bad.yml dev/e2e-pltrav/docker-compose.yml
exec git add .
exec git commit -m 'fix: path traversal bind'
cd ..

exec apinfra
stderr 'security_violation'
stderr 'disallowed_bind_mount'
stderr 'volume policy violation'
stderr 'WARN cycle finished with errors'
stderr 'done duration='
grep 'disallowed_bind_mount' $HOME/.events
docker-assert-running apinfra_e2e-pltrav-web

-- .apinfra.template --
namespace=dev
repoBranch=main

-- git-repo/dev/settings.yml --
version: "1.0"
projects:
  - name: e2e-pltrav
    enabled: true
    proxy:
      inbound:
        port: 9984
      target:
        service:
          name: web
          port: 80
    config:
      cert-issue-type: none

-- git-repo/dev/e2e-pltrav/docker-compose.yml --
services:
  web:
    image: hashicorp/http-echo:latest
    command: ["-listen=:80", "-text=OK"]

-- compose.bad.yml --
services:
  web:
    image: hashicorp/http-echo:latest
    command: ["-listen=:80", "-text=OK"]
    volumes:
      - ../settings.yml:/etc/app/leak.yml:ro

-- .env --
